title: Get Terms
content_data:
Use this endpoint to get the agreement for the Lead Generation Ads feature. You must specify the feature that you want to request the agreement for using the `term_type` field. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Change{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/term/get/|/v1.3/term/get/| |Request parameter data type |`advertiser_id`: number|`advertiser_id`: string| ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/term/get/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162). | ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {Required}|string|Advertiser ID| |lang |string|The language of the agreement. Enum values: `EN`,`JA`,`ZH`
Default value: `EN`.| |term_type {Required}|string|Type of agreement. Enum values: `LeadAds`.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --get -H "Access-Token:xxx" \ --data-urlencode "advertiser_id=< advertiser_id >" \ --data-urlencode "lang=< lang >" \ --data-urlencode "term_type=< term_type >" \ https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/term/get/ (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|Return code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message |string|Return messages. For details, see [Appendix-Return information](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |data |object|Returned data. | #|terms |string[]|The content of the agreement.| |request_id |string|The log id of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "message": "OK", "code": 0, "data": { "terms": [ "Please refer to the following link,", "https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/policy/lead-gen-terms" ] }, "request_id": "2021061803333901023604122050CA85D1" } (/code); ```
